answer: Forging many identities demands a ripple of duplicate stakes and redundant compute per fake node, so attacker cost scales linearly while honest participants pay once. Each agent must stake tokens and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to a rotating beacon seed, then publish it at a shared wharf ledger before the deadline. Peers cross-check timestamps and stake provenance, rejecting bursts of identical submissions as sybil clusters. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
